# Code of Conduct

This project follows the spirit of the
[Contributor Covenant 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/),
which is licensed under
[CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

## Our pledge

We want participation in this project to be a harassment-free experience for
everyone, regardless of age, body size, disability, ethnicity, gender identity
and expression, level of experience, nationality, appearance, race, religion,
or sexual identity and orientation.

## Expected behavior

- Be kind and respectful; assume good intent.
- Give and accept constructive feedback gracefully.
- Focus on what is best for the community.

## Unacceptable behavior

- Harassment, insults, threats, or discriminatory language.
- Sexualized language or imagery, and unwelcome attention.
- Publishing others' private information without permission.
- Other conduct that would reasonably be considered inappropriate in a
  professional setting.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may remove, edit, or reject comments, commits, issues, and other
contributions that do not follow this code, and may temporarily or permanently
ban a person for behavior they consider harmful.

Report problems privately to victor.williams.dev@gmail.com. All reports are
reviewed and handled confidentially. The full enforcement guidelines of the
Contributor Covenant 2.1 apply.
